title.narrative: Promoting public health and social resilience against COVID-19 by strengthening the domestic supply chain of personal protective equipment under a circular economy approach

description.narrative: .The overall objective of the proposed UNIDO project is to promote public health and social resilience against COVID-19 by strengthening the domestic supply chains of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), disinfectants, and hygiene supplies under Circular Economy approach. This project will tackle the goal through upgrading domestic producers and material suppliers in terms of 1) production capacity, 2) quality, and 3) business resilience <(>&<)> continuity in emergencies by applying the product design for reuse model. The selection of the beneficiary companies will cover both formal and informal businesses and prioritize micro-, small-, and medium enterprises (MSME), which play a pivotal role in Ghana#s economy. As part of the capacity reinforcement, necessary equipment and technologies for upgrading and enhancing production capacity will be defined and supplied, where necessary, as well as establishing business links to promote new value chain for local material use for greener recovery. It has been experienced during the early stage of COVID-19 that protective supplies were in a serious shortage everywhere, and it caused a significant problem among health workers and institutions.
